name: Maryann G. Barrios
office: City of El Monte, City Treasurer

items.text: Maryann G. Barrios is a retired analyst and retired certified public accountant running for El Monte City Treasurer. She says she has a bachelor's degree in business administration and years of experience in the nonprofit sector. As treasurer, she says she would support greater financial transparency, regular reviews of revenue and spending, and long-term financial planning.
